title: [Feature][Ops] Gather RoPE cos/sin rows from the contiguous flat base
body:
## Why

Every MTP draft step calls `get_cos_and_sin_mla(positions)` to gather RoPE cos/sin rows. On NPU, indexing the **strided per-half views** (`_cos_cache[positions]`, `_sin_cache[positions]`) makes `aclnnIndex` materialize the **entire cache table** on every lookup, while the effective payload is only `bs * rotary_dim * 2` bytes:

- 1M-row BF16 cache => ~134 MB written / ~250 MB read per lookup, ~420 us each;
- with MTP K=5 that is **12 full-cache materializations per decode step** (2 lookups x 6 forwards), ~4.2 ms/step (~5.7% of the step period) on GLM-5.2 DP16 x TP2.

(GPU keeps lazy views; the NPU aclnn path does not, so the row gather degenerates into a full-table copy.)

## What

Register a contiguous **flat view of the interleaved base table** at registration time (`_cos_sin_flat`, where `_cos_cache[i] == flat[2i]` and `_sin_cache[i] == flat[2i+1]`) and gather rows from it (`flat[positions*2]` / `flat[positions*2+1]`). The flat base is contiguous, so the same row gather is a plain copy (~10 us):

- the fast path is **unconditional** — no config switch. The fix is zero-risk (bitwise identical) and benefits every model on the interleaved-registration path (DeepSeek-V3.2 family, GLM, Kimi, ...);
- the legacy strided gather remains as the fallback for registrations that do not provide the flat view (the non-interleaved `_record_cos_and_sin_cache` path resets it to `None`);
- the flat view shares storage with the registered derived buffers, so the sleep-mode wake restore that rebuilds them in place covers it as well.

## Correctness

**Bitwise identical** to the legacy path: same physical storage, same rows, integer-only index arithmetic (`positions * 2` / `+ 1` on int indices), pure byte copy, identical out-of-bounds domain (`2p < 2N ⟺ p < N`). Proven by unit tests (`tests/ut/ops/test_rotary_flat_gather.py`): flat-vs-fallback bitwise equality (duplicates / empty / boundary positions / `use_cache` path), plus registration semantics (storage sharing with the derived buffers, first-wins, non-interleaved override resets the flat view).

## Performance

Measured on GLM-5.2 (2x Atlas A3, 32 dies, DP16 x TP2, EP32, MTP K=5): removes **12 full-cache materializations per decode step (~4.2 ms/step)**; each lookup becomes ~10 us regardless of cache size, reversing the size sensitivity of the legacy path (whose cost was proportional to the full 1M-row table, independent of batch/context).

## Testing

- [x] `py_compile` + structural assertions for touched files
- [x] New UT: `tests/ut/ops/test_rotary_flat_gather.py`
- [x] NPU server validation (trace assertion: `aclnnIndex_SliceAiCore_Slice` on the rope lookup path 12/step -> 0; draft token sequence bit-identical vs legacy path)

Measured on GLM-5.2 (2 x A3, 32 dies, PD disaggregation, DP2 x TP16, EP32, MTP K=5):

**The ITL is optimized by ~3.5ms**

**NOTE:** This is the first of two PRs splitting #18219 (the two features are file-orthogonal and independently revertable). The sibling PR (multistream MTP metadata overlap) will be submitted separately; #18219 can be closed once both land.
